notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE for 3AM CORP The Balbazar Resort! (1.21)
notes.notes:
Hello ya'll! I listened to the reviews and criticism of the game, and did my absolute best to get things in a better place. Wish I could have got this up sooner, but I got carried away and got deep into making my next game.

This is 3AM CORP: The Balbazar Resort 1.21. The update includes:

- A prompt system. Some people mentioned that they didn't know what to do. This prompt system makes things more obvious for what the player must do to complete the game.
- Better context with the subtitles. Again, to help people understand what to do I tried to contextualise the story and ideas better with the subtitles that happen in the game.
- General bug fixes. There were a handful of small / medium bugs which I've addressed.

Also, I just want to say. I am a solo developer, and this is my first game of all time. So bear with me. Thanks! Alien Big Cat
